newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stock market closed for New Year holiday.
newsitem.headline: KL stock market closed for New Year holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian stock market is closed on Wednesday for the New Year holiday and will re-open for trading on Thursday.
On Tuesday, year-end portfolio adjustments lifted blue chips sharply. The Composite Index ended the year at 1,237.96, up 23.27 points or 1.92 percent. For 1996, the index gained 24.4 percent.
Small-cap shares finished out the year in quieter fashion, with the Second Board index gaining 0.12 percent or 0.68 points to 576.31 on Tuesday. The index jumped 93 percent for the year.
